productDecisionNotes: Flag (ARCHITECTURE.md) has no status field and only exists on a successful GitHub issue creation (issueUrl/usedTokenId/templateId/postedAt all present). MODULES.md's M07 exit criterion 'failures are visible' is therefore represented as Finding.status=FAILED rows mixed into the same Flags history table/list, NOT a fabricated Flag.status field. FLAGGED rows show a real issue reference, template, and masked token reference; FAILED rows show a red FAILED badge and a plain failure-reason string in the Issue/Detail column (e.g. 'GitHub API rate limit (403)', 'Issue creation failed: repo archived', 'Token revoked before retry') with Template and Token columns left blank, since neither exists for a failed attempt. A subtitle reinforces the mix at a glance (e.g. '128 flag attempts · 121 successful · 7 failed').

No destructive-confirmation dialog was invented for a 'retry failed flag' action: ARCHITECTURE.md places retry/backoff entirely inside the BullMQ worker (automatic exponential backoff on 403/429), not as a user-facing manual retry button, so no such control was designed. Flagged here as an open product-decision gap if the product later wants a manual user-facing retry.
No disabled-state frame was designed: this is a read-only history view with no interactive disabled controls, consistent with FIGMA_WORKFLOW.md's 'do not create fake states.'

backend.summary: apps/worker/src/flagger.worker.ts consumes flag-queue jobs: picks least-recently-used active token skipping near-rate-limit ones, renders MessageTemplate ({{repo}}/{{file}}/{{rule}}), self-heals a default template row if missing, opens a GitHub issue via new createGithubIssue()/GithubApiError in github-client.ts, writes a Flag row + transitions Finding APPROVED->FLAGGED inside a Prisma transaction (race-safe via conditional updateMany), or on failure marks Finding FAILED with a short non-secret failureReason and lets BullMQ's existing exponential backoff (3 attempts) retry. Writes an AuditLog row (userId=null, action=flag_created|flag_failed) on every attempt per ARCHITECTURE.md §8 — this was a gap found and fixed during the module's own security-audit pass. apps/web/lib/queue.ts (new) enqueues a flag-queue job from POST /api/findings/:id/approve (apps/web/app/api/findings/[id]/approve/route.ts, shared file, additive change) right after the existing APPROVED transition commits; enqueue failure is logged and does not fail the request. apps/web/lib/flags.ts + GET /api/flags (new) list flag attempts (FLAGGED Finding+Flag join, or FAILED Finding alone) merged/sorted by postedAt, with status filter (FLAGGED/FAILED) and summary counts. Schema: added nullable Finding.failureReason and Flag.postedAt index via new additive migration 20260816150000_add_flag_failure_reason_and_index (no destructive change; prisma validate passed; prisma generate re-run). Seeded a default MessageTemplate row in prisma/seed.ts.

integration.summary: Full vertical slice verified end-to-end at the code level: Figma contract -> flags-client.tsx -> GET /api/flags -> lib/flags.ts -> Prisma (Finding+Flag+GithubToken+MessageTemplate joins), and the write path Admin approve -> enqueueFlagJob -> flag-queue -> flagger.worker.ts -> Flag row / FAILED Finding -> visible in the same Flags list. No live Postgres/Redis instance was available in this environment (.env has no DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL configured) so the flow was verified via `npx prisma validate`, `npx prisma generate`, full workspace typecheck, `next build` (route /dashboard/flags and /api/flags both compiled into the build's route manifest), and unit/integration tests with a faithful in-memory Prisma-shaped mock (not a live DB) — this is the same verification depth used by M04/M06's existing test suites in this repo.

security.summary: Ran the security-audit skill checklist against this module's code: raw secrets never persisted (Flag/Finding schema unchanged in that respect; failureReason is a fixed classification string, never raw error/body); GithubToken.encrypted never selected in lib/flags.ts or logged anywhere in flagger.worker.ts/queue.ts/approve route (grepped for console.* touching token/encrypted — zero matches); decryption stays in-memory via the existing withGithubClient pattern; GET /api/flags requires an authenticated session (requireSession), approve route remains admin-only (requireAdmin, unchanged); retries cannot duplicate a Flag row (Flag.findingId unique + conditional updateMany guard); failed flag attempts are visible (Finding.status=FAILED + failureReason); input validated via zod (flagsListQuerySchema); error responses carry only generic zod issue messages, no stack traces or secrets. One real gap found during this pass and fixed: ARCHITECTURE.md §8 requires every flag action to hit AuditLog (who/when/which token/which template) — the initial flagger.worker.ts draft didn't write one; added recordAuditEvent() calls (action=flag_created|flag_failed, userId=null since it's a system action) on every success/failure path, with a dedicated test asserting the audit detail string never contains a token value.
